s1: Your Chog is not a picture. It is a creature with a career. This is Chog Chaos League: nineteen sixty-nine Chog Genesis NFTs, alive in one pixel meadow on Monad.
s2: Every hour, a new round begins. Chogs cause chaos on their own: prank heists, meme duels, meadow races, and alliance betrayals. So the meadow is fun to watch, even when you never touch it.
s3: This is a real Chog, straight from the contract, with its real art. Its traits decode into five genes: Mischief, Nerve, Wit, Speed and Charm. The mapping table is public, built from the actual metadata, so the same Chog always has the same genome.
s4: Now the part that matters. Every round is seeded by a Monad block hash. Press replay, and your browser re-runs the exact same engine from the stored inputs, then compares the hash. Identical. Rules are code, and the narration is only text, so it can never change a result.
s5: You can even check the seed against Monad itself. And the fairness page publishes every formula, every weight, and every trait value.
s6: Here is where the NFT becomes essential. Connect a wallet with no Chog, and you simply cannot play. The daily nudge, Bold, Sneaky or Friendly, belongs to holders only. The server checks the owner on Monad before it records anything.
s7: Sixteen automated tests prove it: the engine, the real trait table, replays, Merkle proofs, and that a non-owner is rejected.
s8: And the career follows the token. Season results roll into a Merkle root, anchored on Monad by our Chaos Ledger contract. This badge re-checks the proof in your browser, against the chain. The record travels with the token, not the wallet.
s9: Seasons, streaks and badges drive the leaderboard, and every notable moment becomes a highlight card, ready to share on X, with a replay link anyone can verify.
s10: Remove the NFT, and there is no creature, no genes, no nudge, and no career. Spectating stays free. Playing needs a Chog. Chog Chaos League: your Chog is the creature, the key, and the career record. Try it live now.
